revision_history.timing: before v3 fit bundles, labels, datasets, model training, or metrics
revision_history.content: fixed scenes, all-object inventory, LLR method, recipe constants, LOO gates

revision_history.timing: after label-free scene0002/scene0005 bundle materialization but before any v3 fit label opening or dataset generation
revision_history.content: made the equal-class stratified BCE estimator explicitly reweight strata by true prevalence; no method constant changed

revision_history.timing: after scene0000 fit shard generation began but before any v3 head training or source metric computation
revision_history.content: defined foreground mass as mean inferred probability and fixed epsilon=1e-8; no training method, threshold, or gate changed

revision_history.timing: after scene0000 all-object shard materialization exposed one official object with zero registered primitive positives, but before any v3 head training or source metric computation
revision_history.content: retain every legal official object in materialization and evaluation; omit only undefined BCE/ranking training examples having no positive or no negative primitive target, with the omitted inventory reported; no metric object is omitted

revision_history.timing: after all fit shard materialization but before any v3 head training or source metric computation
revision_history.content: direct registered likelihood is compiled as T*logit((1-c)*0.5+c*q) before the solver, replacing the lossy c*(2q-1)-then-sigmoid double link; no learned parameter, threshold, or scene-specific choice was added

design_provenance.v2_observation: directional click response transferred, but class-balanced-plus-Dice posterior was foreground-heavy and absolute calibration declined
design_provenance.v3_development_role: development iteration only after all source gates pass

object_contract.legal_object_definition: every positive instance id present in the official 5cm first-occurrence quantized fit-scene labels with at least one foreground and one background point
object_contract.training_support_rule: all objects are stored and evaluated; a scene/object contributes to the primitive LLR loss iff its fixed official point-to-primitive mapping yields at least one positive and one negative primitive, because class-conditional BCE/ranking is otherwise undefined
object_contract.click_simulator: fixed nearest-signed source trajectory, ten prefixes, one worker

evidence_contract.direct_solver_unary: T*logit((1-c)*0.5+c*q), so solver sigmoid(unary/T) exactly recovers the confidence-conditioned likelihood
evidence_contract.source_gate_readout: raw q=sigmoid(ell) through the fixed continuous Gaussian readout; no graph or hard-seed extent is credited to the head-only source gate

mathematical_contract.head: generic monotone two-channel signed log-likelihood-ratio head
mathematical_contract.monotonicity: d ell / d positive affinity >=0 and d ell / d negative affinity <=0
mathematical_contract.bias_semantics: b is the class-conditional likelihood normalization after analytic prevalence separation, not an empirical foreground-prior intercept
mathematical_contract.ranking_loss: mean softplus(-(ell_positive-ell_negative)) over deterministic equal-count positive/negative pairs
mathematical_contract.why_prior_invariant: both ell_positive-ell_negative and logit(p_e)-logit(pi_e) are invariant to fit object prevalence
mathematical_contract.why_no_dice: Dice directly rewards foreground mass and is not a proper probability calibration loss

training_recipe.posterior_bce_sampling_semantics: prevalence-weighted stratified estimator of ordinary per-primitive BCE; class strata are sampled equally only for variance reduction and are reweighted by their true population prevalence, never by 0.5/0.5 class-balanced weights
training_recipe.training_row_selection: lowest stable SHA256(scene_id,object_id,click_count,primitive_row) keys independently per class

source_validation.reference: the frozen v2 checkpoint replayed on exactly the same heldout source examples
source_validation.if_any_gate_fails: do not open scene0003 development labels and do not run test312

reported_diagnostics: IoU precision recall, thresholded foreground fraction, and probability foreground mass by click count
target foreground fraction and absolute log probability-mass-to-target-mass ratio, with epsilon 1e-8
v2 versus v3 under identical source examples
